compatibility.display_state_rule: display_state is computed by SportsLiveInfo (day assets: as of the collection that produced the event; live rows: as of their build); show it as published while now < state_until_utc (absent: until the status changes). Order: postponed, cancelled, finished (finished_at_utc when known); live while start_utc <= now < live_until_utc; tbc for date_only/time_tbc events; then the clock: upcoming until start_utc - 30 min, starting_soon until start_utc, should_be_on until expected_end_utc + 30 min, then finished without finished_at_utc (probably finished). A reader past state_until_utc applies the same order with its own clock.
compatibility.history_rule: window.history_from is the Europe/London day before today. The optional asset events:<history_from> (required false, tier core, same schema) carries that day's events with their last known status, including finished and, when approved and known, the final score; broadcast_links name the channels the guides listed. It is never in today. Older days are not published. Readers use it to recognise a replay of an event that already finished.
compatibility.link_rule: broadcast_links are published best first (rank 1 = best); keep that order. A link with binds=true may name the channel showing the event; binds=false is 'may be on' only. binds is true for a guide-corroborated link, or a high-confidence curated channel of the owner's or the event's home market (home_market=true); a status you do not know is guide_listed_unverified
compatibility.live_overlay_rule: overlay the optional 'live' asset on the day assets by event id when its status_observed_at is newer; a feed older than 45 minutes never makes anything 'LIVE'
compatibility.live_state_rule: status_normalized == 'live' is trusted only when status_observed_at is at most 45 minutes old AND start_utc <= now <= expected_end_utc + 30 minutes. Otherwise treat it as unknown and fall back to the clock (start..expected_end) shown as 'should be on now', never 'LIVE'.
compatibility.live_until_rule: when an event (or its live-asset row) has live_until_utc, show LIVE only while start_utc <= now < live_until_utc; without it apply live_state_rule
compatibility.on_major_mismatch: keep last good feed; show 'update B1G to read the newer SportsLiveInfo feed'

scores.rule: score.home is the score of participants[0] and score.away the score of participants[1], whatever their home or away role; a reader that cannot pair a score with exactly two participants ignores it. period is one of 1H HT 2H ET PEN FT AET Q1-Q4 P1-P3 OT or null; there is no minute. events:<date> rows carry the final score of a finished event only; the live asset carries the live score (status live, show it only while LIVE holds, never after live_until_utc) and a final score read after the event. score.source is the SportsLiveInfo source id and score.observed_at when it was read. A score is absent when uncertain; absent means unknown, never 0-0. Disabled by omitting compatibility.scores.

standings.rule: Take a competition's table only from its standings:<competition_id> asset, and only while the manifest lists the capability standings and carries rights.standings with enabled true (otherwise show none from the feed and drop any cached feed table). Show the table as complete only when table_complete is true; teams < expected_teams (or a false table_complete) is a partial table. Do not show a table whose observed_at is older than rights.standings.max_age_days. Show the attribution lines. Rows are in position order within each group; group.name is null for a single league table (league phase included) and the group's name for cup groups. Match rows to events by participant name, or by participant_id (fd:<football-data team id>, as:<API-Sports team id>).

compatibility.tier_rule: events:<date> and today carry tier 'core'; the optional events_extra:<date> assets (same schema) carry tier 'extra'
compatibility.time_precision_rule: start_precision date_only or time_tbc: start_utc is 00:00 Europe/London of that date (23:00Z in summer, 00:00Z in winter), never a clock time; show the date or 'time TBC', not the clock. expected_end_utc is then only the sport default after that placeholder and must not be shown.

ranking.rule: feature_rank = clamp(0..100, sport_weight + competition_points + featured_competition + team_points + ppv + corroboration + link + session - penalties). sport_weight 0-20 per sport (football 20, rugby union and motorsport 16, cricket/tennis/boxing 14, ... other sports 3). competition_points = max(0, 40 - category_priority) for a named category (id not ending '.other'), else 0; +5 when competition_id is in display_policy.featured_competition_ids. team_points: team:england, england_women, great_britain, lions 20; scotland, wales, northern_ireland, ireland (and their women's sides) 15; any other team:* tag 5; ppv +25. +5 when corroboration >= 2. +5 when a broadcast link has binds=true, else +2 when there is any link. F1 sessions: race +10, qualifying/sprint +5, sprint qualifying +3, practice -10. Penalties: -10 when start_precision is date_only or time_tbc, -15 when tier is extra. Ties are broken by start_utc, then id.

notices: Asset dictionary is 83% of the 8 MiB reader limit (alert at 80%).

refresh.collected_at_expected: collected_at is when the sports collection behind the day assets last completed; generated_at is only when this manifest was built (a live-lane publish renews it). A collected_at older than the expected_interval_minutes plus a grace means the collection has stalled even though the feed looks fresh: show 'collection stale'. Absent: unknown, fall back to generated_at.
